neighbours.label: a 'nothing more than the baseline' qualifier: 'the same' for what a placebo or control group receives, 'simply because', 'merely/only to ensure'
fire: The placebo arm was given the same tablets but without the active compound.
The sham group underwent the same surgery but with no implant placed.
Controls drank the same beverage but without any caffeine in it.
The log line exists merely to ensure that the hook was called.
The fence is there only to ensure that children stay off the road.
Sales may have dropped because of the weather, or simply because prices went up.
Perhaps the dog barks out of fear, or simply because it is bored.
The untreated group attended the same clinic visits but without the therapy.
quiet: The twins wore the same jackets to the party on Saturday.
My cousin drives the same car that her father once owned.
The placebo arm was given sugar tablets every morning for a month.
The sham group recovered faster than the surgeons had expected.
The log line records the time at which the hook was called.
The fence was painted green by the children last summer.
Sales dropped sharply when the weather turned cold in March.
The dog barks loudly whenever the postman comes to the door.

notes: Card: no single token (only, same, ensure, simply, verifying); the output direction promotes base, baseline, basic, generic, trivial. Probes were weak and uneven: placebo 'the same' 0.31-0.35, 'simply because' 0.32 and 0.04, 'merely to ensure' 0.20, plain 'the same school' 0.03. A list-like label; likely to fail.
